tools.name: process_images
tools.description: Resize, crop, rotate, flip, compress (to a file size with target_bytes), convert (jpeg, png, webp, avif), strip EXIF and GPS metadata from, and watermark (text, logo or both) one image or a zip of up to 50 images (up to 500 files per zip; files that are not supported images are skipped and listed).

tools.name: create_upload
tools.description: Get a one-hour signed upload URL for an image or a zip that is too large to send inline (over 3 MB; up to 100 MB here) or that already sits on disk. PUT the raw bytes to upload_url with a Content-Length header, then pass file_id to process_images. Free.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_upload · Private data: process_images · Public sink: create_upload · Destructive: process_images.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_upload · Private data: process_images · Public sink: create_upload · Destructive: process_images

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
